Each sheet is the space around the star as a rubber sheet, with true proper lengths. Gold = star; brighter = denser.
A fixes the physical density (matter term phi^+5): two answers for one star; they merge at the fold, then none.
B, the textbook rescaling (phi^-3), and C, densitized (phi^-1): one answer for any amount of matter.
But only A delivers the density you typed in, and only C the matter. B delivers neither.
C is a toy in the spirit of Isenberg-Maxwell's conformally invariant matter, not their perfect-fluid equations.
